upstream.policy: pinned; no silent tracking of upstream main

worker_lanes.worker-1: platform substrate, migration, product surfaces, and role experience
worker_lanes.worker-2: cross-device coordination, resource contribution, gateway runtime, and provider integration
worker_lanes.worker-3: Reality Lab, Organizations, group purchasing, economic opportunities, and simulation

completed_work_orders.limitation: Only architecture/governance documents are recorded as complete. No product feature, test suite, real-device forwarding, provider execution, or deployment is thereby declared implemented.

acceptance_rule: Do not mark implementation work complete without commits, reproducible tests, and the evidence required by its work order.
